mapper.select:
select * from orders
and number like concat('%', #{number}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by order_time desc
select * from orders where id = #{id} for update
mapper.update: update orders set status = 3, tracking_company = #{trackingCompany}, tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}, delivery_time = #{deliveryTime} where id = #{id} and status = 2 and pay_status = 1 and stock_deducted = 1
mapper.select: select * from orders where pay_status = 1 order by order_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into orders ( number, status, user_id, order_time, checkout_time, pay_method, pay_status, amount, remark, phone, address, user_name, consignee, cancel_reason, rejection_reason, cancel_time, estimated_delivery_time, delivery_status, delivery_time, shipping_fee, address_book_id, tracking_company, tracking_number, user_coupon_id, original_price, seckill_activity_id, seckill_coupon_id, is_seckill, seckill_price, stock_deducted ) values ( #{number}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{orderTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{payMethod}, #{payStatus}, #{amount}, #{remark}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{userName}, #{consignee}, #{cancelReason}, #{rejectionReason}, #{cancelTime}, #{estimatedDeliveryTime}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{deliveryTime}, #{shippingFee}, #{addressBookId}, #{trackingCompany}, #{trackingNumber}, #{userCouponId}, #{originalPrice}, #{seckillActivityId}, #{seckillCouponId}, #{isSeckill}, #{seckillPrice}, #{stockDeducted} )
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, u.name AS userName FROM orders o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id ORDER BY o.order_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
select * from orders where status = 1 and pay_status = 0 and is_seckill = 0 and order_time < date_sub(now(), interval #{minutes} minute) and id > #{afterId} order by id asc limit #{limit}
